input: Negotiate the freelance contract rate before signing

gold.taskTitle: Negotiate Freelance Contract Rate Before Signing
gold.taskDescription: Prepare for and carry out a negotiation to secure a better rate on a freelance contract before committing to it.

questions.title: What is the client or company offering you this contract?
questions.description: Identify who the other party in this negotiation is.

questions.title: What rate are they currently offering you?
questions.description: Establish the baseline number on the table before negotiation begins.

questions.title: What is your target rate you want to reach?
questions.description: Define the specific number or range the user is aiming to achieve.

questions.title: Is this rate hourly, per project, or a retainer?
questions.description: Clarify the payment structure of the contract being negotiated.

questions.title: When does the contract need to be signed by?
questions.description: Determine the deadline driving the urgency of this negotiation.

questions.title: Have you negotiated with this client before?
questions.description: Understand the existing relationship and negotiation history with this party.

questions.title: What is your biggest concern going into this negotiation?
questions.description: Surface the primary fear or blocker the user wants help addressing.
